source_context: The user asked GPT-6 to autonomously select another worthwhile LeanFrontier formalization. GPT-6 checked current upstream and fork, read the accepted Horadam development and the current roadmap, and searched for characteristic-root formulas in the corpus and Mathlib. It selected a division-free Binet representation of Horadam sequences in any commutative ring, including coincident roots and positive characteristic, together with its difference-of-powers companion. The target is self-contained and does not rely on the still-open binomial recurrence transform PR. GPT-6 authored the Lean statements, proof, and provenance record, without human Lean text contributions.
